Methodology / transparent by design

Evidence has a chain.

AIMD is designed to make the work inspectable. No single signal is treated as definitive proof, and every unavailable signal stays visible.

ML
Metadata
Frequency
Compression
Noise
Fingerprint
01

File validation

The backend validates the extension, image content, size, and safe storage path before analysis.

02

Metadata extraction

AIMD reads dimensions, format, mode, and available EXIF fields. Missing metadata is not proof of AI generation.

03

Cryptographic identity

SHA-256 identifies the exact artifact. A perceptual hash supports visual similarity checks after resizing or compression.

04

Forensic measurements

Frequency, compression-boundary, and noise-residual measurements stay visible as contextual evidence.

05

ML classification

The open-weight vision model provides AI and human probabilities when its runtime is available.

06

Ensemble assessment

A transparent baseline combines available evidence and returns a verdict, confidence note, strength, and reasoning.

Uncertainty statement

AI detection is probabilistic and can produce false positives and false negatives. Ensemble confidence is a baseline assessment, not automatically a calibrated probability.

Current boundary

The current implementation analyzes images. Video, audio, localization, verified provenance, and report generation are not presented as implemented capabilities.
